newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia bonds little changed after rate cut.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia bonds little changed after rate cut.

text.p: Australian bond and bill futures showed a fairly muted response to news that the Reserve Bank had cut 50 basis points off official interest rates to 6.5 percent, a move that has been priced in for some time.
The December 10-year bond futures contract seesawed around its 92.745 pre-announcement level, while December bill futures shaded slightly to 93.58 from 93.59.
The central bank said the cut reflected Australia's improved inflation outlook and that 3.5 percent wages growth was compatible with its 2-3 percent inflation target.
